game_title: Off By One Autopsy – Buried Temple Steps Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps, steps of a half-buried temple: the camel trader must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps: steps of a half-buried temple
core_gameplay_loop: In Buried Temple Steps, repeat each round: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script. Each round, sandstorms strike the camel pen, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the autopsy value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the camel pen from sandstorms in Buried Temple Steps: keep the autopsy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: autopsy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 63-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Off By One Autopsy
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Buried Temple Steps'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how autopsy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Buried Temple Steps.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 63 seconds while autopsy > 0.
